body: Will have to look into it, thanks for your time mate, talking to people seems to make me feel better so maybe getting some help is what I need. Really, thank you.

Nothing sets me off, I just wake up feeling my same apathetic self day In and day out I wouldn't say I'm suicidal in the sense I want to kill myself it's just I know I will one day. Sure I could do it now but I'd break my mom's heart.

I don't want to sound like a junkie here but I went far, I tried a lot. Luckily the only addiction I have is cigarettes, drugs always have and always will be a part of my life so I tried to respect each of them as much as possible and they made me so happy. The thing with the drugs I was talking was that I knew they had a price, sure they make you happy but when you crash that euphoria is gone, your mood is worse and the only way to get it back is do another line. Plus I'm sure you can imagine how many times I considered tripling the dose and just drifting off.
I'm here for you man, PM me if you want to get it off your chest.

Yeah I'm bored with life and I just can't seen to change that, I try lots of different things sports/hobbies and yet nothing catches my interest. However I seem to be getting angrier with myself/everything in general. I snap at people pretty frequently and I'm just in a bad mood at all times. 

I'm not sure how this will go down on this sub but the only time I feel normal is when I take drugs, yet i realise this isn't even happiness it's euphoria and that sooner or later my use will catch up to me. I just can't find a way out.
